name: Candlefell
summary:
There is no attack button. Your weapon follows your swing.

Candlefell is a single-player dark fantasy action RPG where every fight is won by hand. A short cut and a full overhead with the same sword are different attacks. Your arm decides. Enemies wind up before they strike: turn the blow with your off hand, raise your guard to take the edge off, or step aside. Then answer.
